hooks: Raat ko Bhai ka phone chamka, news thi, Zerodha par ab US stocks milenge.
topic.summary: A 12-minute illustrated documentary on the question of the Short "US Stocks 1 dollar se? Asli kharcha kya hai", which reached 1,473 people on Instagram. Go deeper than the Short: the mechanism, a worked example in rupees, the mistakes people make, what to check. Story so far: Zerodha has launched beta access to US stocks and ETFs through its Kite platform, letting eligible Indian residents invest in up to 2,000 companies and around 1,000 funds, with fractional investing from $1. The service supports delivery orders only and charges brokerage.&nbsp;
topic.title: US Stocks 1 dollar se? Asli kharcha kya hai
